intended_object: The functorial change-of-coefficients homomorphism D_n(R) → D_n(S) on invertible diagonal matrices induced by a ring homomorphism f : R → S, applying f entrywise (inferred from docstring, name, and the lemmas map_apply/unitsEquiv_map).
explanation: The definition restricts Mathlib's GeneralLinearGroup.map f to the diagonal subgroup, checking off-diagonal entries map to f(0)=0; the multiplicativity is inherited. This is exactly the entrywise base-change homomorphism on the diagonal group. The setting is fully general: any finite decidable index type and any commutative rings. The only restriction is that R and S share a universe with ι, which comes from the library's setup of DiagonalGroup and is not a mathematical narrowing. Mathlib has no dedicated diagonal-subgroup map; the closest construction is Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map, which this restricts.
